name: Lin Changqing
profile: Lin Changqing (林长青) appears on the 2021 Hurun China list via Medicilon, a Shanghai preclinical CRO. Shareholder disclosures describe him as a relative by marriage of Medicilon co-controller Chen Jinzhang (nephew-in-law) and of shareholder Chen Guoxing (brother-in-law). No further public profile found.
interesting_fact: Medicilon's actual controllers are founder Chun-Lin Chen and Chen Jinzhang (acting-in-concert agreement); several other shareholders, including Lin, are their relatives but not acting-in-concert parties.
notes: Very low public profile; relationship info from a search-result summary of Sohu shareholder disclosure (page could not be loaded directly). Contact is Medicilon's company marketing email, not personal.

name: Zhang Guoxiang
profile: Listed on Hurun China (2008-2016) as Zhang Guoxiang (张国祥), source of wealth 'Juxing' (real estate/construction). Three searches found no source linking this name to a Juxing (巨星) group, so identity could not be confirmed.
notes: Could not identify; company name 'Juxing' is ambiguous (several unrelated 巨星 companies). Last appeared on Hurun in 2016.

name: Huang Jiman
profile: Listed on Hurun China (2015) as Huang Jiman (黄继满) with wealth from 'Sha Steel' (steel). Searches found no source linking this name to Shagang/Jiangsu Shagang (002075.SZ) or any other steel company, so identity could not be confirmed.
notes: Could not identify; possibly a minority shareholder tied to Jiangsu Shagang's 2015-era ownership, but unverified. Only one Hurun appearance (2015).

name: Sui Guodong
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Zhidemai Technology (值得买科技, SMZDM, 300785.SZ)
profile: Sui Guodong (隋国栋) founded SMZDM ('What's Worth Buying'), China's shopping-recommendation and consumer-content platform, in 2010 and took it public in Shenzhen; post-IPO he controlled about 50.8% of the shares. As chairman he focuses on strategy, and in May 2024 launched an 'all-in AI' strategy to rebuild the core app as AI-native and expand overseas.
interesting_fact: In May 2024 he announced a full AI strategy for Zhidemai, planning to turn its core apps into AI-native products and push overseas.
deep_cut_fact: smzdm.com launched on 30 June 2010 as Sui's personal 'geek' blog of product finds and reviews; early on the site would crash if ~300 people visited at once - five years later it drew tens of millions of daily visits.
notes: Company insists on platform neutrality ('我们绝不站队' - won't take investment from any e-commerce platform; ifanr 2015). Reported as first president of the Fengtai District International Chamber of Commerce (search summary, unverified).

name: He Zenglin
current_role: Chairman (and general manager), Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology Co., Ltd. (天和防务, 300397.SZ)
profile: He Zenglin (贺增林) is the founder, chairman and actual controller of Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology, a Shenzhen-listed defense electronics and communications company (about 25% stake per 2026 reporting). A serial Xi'an entrepreneur since the 1990s, he still chairs the company and was listed as chairman and GM in its 2025 filings.
interesting_fact: Before defense electronics he ran a string of Xi'an ventures: an electrical-machinery firm (1994-99), a network-engineering company (2001-05) and even a culture-and-tourism company, Shaanxi Yuhe (2000-10).
deep_cut_fact: His first company was Xi'an Xinfeng Electrical Machinery (西安信风机电), which he chaired and managed from 1994 to 1999, before founding Xi'an Tianwei Electronic System Engineering in 2001.
notes: Hurun listing shared with Liu Danying. Best route is the board secretary office (Chen Hua) via the published IR email.

name: Yang Yinfen
current_role: Director and Honorary Chairman, Bestore Co., Ltd. (良品铺子, 603719.SH)
profile: Yang Yinfen (杨银芬) is a co-founder of Wuhan-based snack retailer Bestore (良品铺子), alongside Yang Hongchun and Zhang Guoqiang. Yang was general manager 2017-2022 and chairman/GM from November 2023, then stepped down in March 2025 for personal reasons, remaining a director and strategy-committee member with the title of honorary chairman.
interesting_fact: As chairman, Yang launched Bestore's biggest-ever price cut in late 2023 - nearly 300 products, by up to 45% - framed as a return to 'good quality at friendly prices'.
deep_cut_fact: Yang championed the 'high quality, high looks, high experience' (高品质、高颜值、高体验) brand concept that repositioned Bestore as a premium snack brand; staff call Yang 'Fen Zong' (芬总).
notes: Sources disagree on gender and join date (one says joined 2010 as director/deputy GM; others cite involvement from ~2008). Avoid the price-cut controversy angle; focus on brand-building.

name: Wen Zhizhou
current_role: Employee-representative Director, Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Co. (海天味业, 603288.SH / 3288.HK)
profile: Wen Zhizhou (文志州) is a long-serving board member of Haitian, China's largest soy-sauce and condiment maker. He is one of six Haitian Group shareholders (with Pang Kang, Cheng Xue, Guan Jianghua, Chen Junyang and Liao Changhui) who signed an acting-in-concert agreement in Dec 2023 and jointly control the listed company (52.69% as of mid-2025); he also directly holds ~8.89m Haitian shares.
interesting_fact: The six-person controlling group he belongs to held 71.80% of Haitian Group, which in turn gives them control of 52.69% of Haitian Flavouring - a rare management-owned controlling structure for a Chinese consumer giant.
deep_cut_fact: On 25 September 2025 he resigned as a regular director and was the same day elected by Haitian's workers' congress as its employee-representative director, also joining the board's Strategy and Sustainability Committee.
notes: Low public profile; no personal bio found. Approach via Haitian's board office / IR (Hong Kong or Shanghai listing disclosures).

name: Liao Daoxun
current_role: Co-actual controller / major shareholder, Visual China Group (视觉中国, 000681.SZ)
profile: Liao Daoxun (廖道训) is one of the ten acting-in-concert shareholders who together control Visual China Group, China's largest licensed image/visual-content platform (they held ~57.95% per Jiemian). VCG listed in 2014 via a backdoor listing into Far East Industrial (000681). He is a shareholder rather than an operating executive.
interesting_fact: VCG went public in 2014 through a CSRC-approved backdoor listing into Jiangsu's Far East Industrial Stock (000681), turning a photo agency into an A-share company.
notes: Very private; no personal bio found. A March 2026 filing showed him (with Wu Yurui and Chai Jijun) trimming VCG shares, suggesting he is still a shareholder. Route via VCG board office.

name: Sun Lijun
current_role: Former Alibaba Group partner; previously GM of Rural Taobao and president of the Alibaba Foundation (current role unconfirmed)
profile: Sun Lijun (孙利军) joined Alibaba's B2B unit in 2002 straight out of Zhejiang University as a junior clerk selling China Supplier memberships, rose to run East China sales, and in 2014 helped launch Rural Taobao across 27 provinces. He was named an Alibaba partner in Dec 2015 and later led the Alibaba Foundation; Yicai reported he left the partnership in fiscal 2025.
interesting_fact: He was named one of four 'new-generation' Alibaba partners in December 2015, explicitly tied to Alibaba's rural e-commerce strategy, as GM of Rural Taobao.
deep_cut_fact: In his first year as an Alibaba B2B salesman (2002) he ranked sixth in sales; by 2006 he was number one, before going on to lead China Supplier Services for East China.
notes: Not to be confused with lawyer Sun Lijun (Ronly & Tenwen). Left Alibaba partnership per Yicai (27 Jun 2025): https://www.yicaiglobal.com/news/alibaba-cut-nine-partners-in-fiscal-year-2025 . Current role unknown; Alibaba Foundation link per China Development Brief.

name: Prithvi Raj Singh Oberoi
current_role: Deceased (died 14 November 2023, aged 94); formerly Chairman Emeritus, The Oberoi Group / EIH Ltd
profile: PRS 'Biki' Oberoi, longtime head of EIH Ltd (Oberoi Hotels), died on 14 November 2023 aged 94, as confirmed by an Oberoi Group statement.
interesting_fact: He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2008.
notes: Deceased 14 Nov 2023 (Business Today, The Week). Skip outreach. EIH now led by Arjun Oberoi (executive chairman) and Vikram Oberoi (CEO/MD).

notes: Could not identify company 'Olo Home Furnishing' or person. Not to be confused with Wang Linpeng (Easyhome/居然之家).

name: Chen Xiao
current_role: Chairman and President, Wenzhou Hongfeng Electrical Alloy Co., Ltd. (温州宏丰, 300283.SZ)
profile: Chen Xiao (陈晓, b. 1969) founded Hongfeng in Yueqing, Zhejiang, in September 1997, making electrical contact alloy materials; the company listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in January 2012. He and Lin Ping are the actual controllers, and he has been chairman since 2010 and chairman/president since 2015.
interesting_fact: He is recognised under Zhejiang's 'Ten Thousand Talents Plan' as a 'technology entrepreneurship leading talent' (科技创业领军人才).
deep_cut_fact: For Hongfeng's first 13 years (1997-2010), Chen was simultaneously executive director, general manager AND finance director of the company, starting from Yueqing Hongfeng Electrical Alloy Materials Co.
notes: Hurun listing shared with Lin Ping (co-actual controller). wzhf@wzhf.com is the company's general email (not a personal office). Holds ~16.6% directly (2024).
